row: GREYED-STEP-OVER-01, the Ask-button half (Down from the box while an answer is in flight) - lane C commit f5f0f79
setup: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor running; a question sent with Ask (the ring landed on the box); two Down presses within about three seconds of the send, while no reply text had arrived yet.
measured: Both Downs left the ring on the question box (moved: false); the greyed Ask button did not take it. About 40 s later, before the reply text had started, a page read showed the Ask button already enabled again, so how long the in-flight window lasts on this build is worth a closer look; the presses themselves fell inside it.
verdict: PASS for the Ask half. The thumbs half (a stopped reply) is still to be pressed.
